name: Git tree, full page
why: The whole page is a commit graph like git log --graph. Each row is one step run. Parallel tasks and loops get colored lanes that merge back, so there are no back arrows. Dashed branches show the ways out of the current step. Best for dense history and loops. Weak for the full shape of the definition.
